stories.title: UP launches govt cab service:Yogi rides Bharat Taxi, says, ‘Earlier, even buffaloes would disappear from bullock carts’
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said in Lucknow on Wednesday, "Before 2017 in Uttar Pradesh, forget two-wheelers and three-wheelers-even if someone travelling in a buffalo cart stopped somewhere for tea, his buffalo would disappear. Taxi tyres would disappear. Earlier, it was impossible to tell whether the road was in a pothole or the pothole was in the road. Today, everything has changed in Uttar Pradesh." Yogi launched 'Bharat Taxi' and a scheme to provide low-interest loans to farmers, and said- "Before 2014 in the country and before 2017 in Uttar Pradesh, conditions were bad. Curfews lasted for months and riots took place. The goons of the ruling party would beat up the driver of any taxi they travelled in and steal the vehicle. Now, the double-engine government has become a source of strength for farmers and the poor." Yogi said, "Farmers were given loans from our cooperative banks at an interest rate of 11%. We have now reduced the interest rate to 6%. Loans of up to ₹10 lakh are available. We will also provide loan facilities to 5 lakh small and marginal farmers." Earlier, the CM launched the portal for the 'Krishak Samriddhi Yojana' and the 'Setu App' for fertilisers and seeds. He also launched the 'Bharat Taxi' service in Lucknow, handed loan cheques to farmers and taxi certificates to drivers. After flagging off Bharat Taxi, the CM also sat in a cab. Key points from Yogi's address- 1. Handing weapons to corrupt hands will only lead to destruction CM Yogi said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah, cooperation is becoming a symbol of the country's prosperity. Cooperation is an important part of our daily lives. However, success depends on who is in charge of the cooperative sector. If weapons are handed to negative and corrupt hands, they will only cause destruction. If power is placed in the hands of people with a positive outlook, the security of society and the nation will be strengthened. Cooperation is a double-edged sword-with one good side and one bad side. With good leadership, cooperation becomes a driver of progress. 2. The poor had been left to fend for themselves At the launch of Bharat Taxi, CM Yogi said that results were now being seen because of the formation of the Ministry of Cooperation. People whom no one used to think about, such as taxi drivers, will now become part of Bharat Taxi with registration and zero commission. In return, they will also receive social security coverage. Until now, they were not provided with any security. They were left to fend for themselves. The skills of a poor person were insulted. Today, when a driver has "Bharat Taxi" written on the car, he will feel proud that it is the taxi of the whole of India. He will have the assurance that he is also receiving a guarantee of social security worth 5 lakh. 3. If a theft occurs, arrangements are in place to deal with it at the next crossroads CM Yogi said that curfews are no longer imposed, riots no longer occur and thefts no longer take place because 14 lakh CCTV cameras have been installed. If a theft occurs somewhere, arrangements are in place to deal with it at the next crossroads. Farmers used to migrate, and were হতाश and निराश. Middlemen held sway. In 2017, we first waived ₹36,000 crore in loans for the food-producing farmers. It took 50 years to complete the Saryu Nagar project because the food-producing farmers were not on their agenda. The Arjun Sahayak Project, the Bansagar Project and the Middle Ganga Project were in the same situation. The double-engine government has provided irrigation facilities to an additional 24 lakh acres of land. This has helped increase farmers' incomes. Earlier, the motors installed in farmers' fields would be stolen. Today, we have made irrigation facilities free and are providing free electricity. 4. When a good government comes to power, it does good work The Chief Minister said that when a good government comes to power, it also does good work. Prime Minister Modi has provided everything from health cards to the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi. In Uttar Pradesh, sugarcane farmers would not receive payment for their sugarcane for years. They would not receive slips after the sugarcane was ready. There was malpractice in the mills. Payments for sugarcane would not be made. Of the 122 sugar mills, more than 100 make payments for sugarcane on the fourth day. Previous governments sold 29 sugar mills at throwaway prices. 5. Once BIMARU, UP is now prosperous; disturbances have turned into celebrations Yogi said that the government had undertaken several initiatives for the food-producing farmers. As a result, once BIMARU, UP is now prosperous; where there were disturbances, there are celebrations today. There is prosperity on every farmer's face. There used to be many difficulties in forming cooperative societies, but today fertiliser is also being distributed through these societies, ensuring that farmers receive fertiliser on time under all circumstances. A campaign has been launched to form PACS. As many as 54 lakh new members have been enrolled in PACS. Before 2017, 16 cooperative banks were operating at a loss. stories.title: Taj Mahal trip turns costly for American couple:2 kids snatch purse packed with dollars and passports; CCTV trail reaches Mathura
stories.summary: Two children stole a purse containing dollars from an American tourist couple in Agra. The purse contained $2,750, along with essential documents and passports. In Indian currency, the amount is worth more than ₹2.5 lakh. After the incident, the tourist couple filed a case at the tourism police station. CCTV footage showed two boys running away with the purse. They had gone to a medical store to buy medicine According to information, the American tourist couple had come to visit Agra with their friend, Nguyen Phuon. They were all staying at the Trident Hotel on Fatehabad Road. At around 5 p.m. on 19 September, the couple went to a medical store in the Tajganj area to buy medicine. After buying the medicine, they paid for it and placed the purse in a bag hanging from the shoulder. Meanwhile, two boys aged nine and 12 at the shop saw them putting money in the purse. It was reported that both boys followed the couple from the shop and began asking them for money. The couple ignored them and continued walking. The chain of the bag hanging from the woman's shoulder had been left open. On their way back to the hotel, the two boys surrounded them again. While engaging them in conversation, one of the boys took the purse from the bag, and both fled the scene. The purse contained more than ₹2.5 lakh The couple told police that the purse contained $2,750, ₹2,000 and their passports. As soon as the information was received, the tourism police examined recordings from CCTV cameras installed around the scene. The footage showed two boys fleeing with the purse. ACP, Taj Security, Yatendra Nagar, said police had traced the boys to Mathura railway station with the help of CCTV footage. The investigation revealed that the two boys lived on the pavement near the Taj Nagari Metro station. The police team is trying to apprehend them and recover the dollars.

stories.title: ₹4.25 crore GST evasion detected in Varanasi:SIB raid lasted 4 days; action against railway contractor and tent house
stories.summary: The Special Investigation Branch (SIB) of the Uttar Pradesh State Tax Department has detected GST evasion worth ₹4.25 crore near the Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW). The SIB has taken action against a railway contractor and a tent house. To uncover the evasion, the SIB continued raids for four days and disclosed the findings late at night. The investigation team raided the area near BLW on the night of 18 September. The operation continued until the night of 22 September. The team has not yet released the names of the contractor or the tent house. Tax paid by concealing manpower supply The SIB investigation has revealed that the railway contractor's firm undertakes civil construction work and supplies manpower to DLW through the government e-marketplace. In the return filed for the financial year 2025-26, the firm concealed the manpower supply. The firm did not file its return for 2026-27, even though it was paid more than ₹5.50 crore between April and August 2026. The tax payable on this amount is more than ₹1 crore, which has not yet been deposited. ₹4.25 crore evasion According to SIB officials, the firm obtained input tax worth ₹36 lakh through fake bills. The investigation revealed tax evasion of around ₹4.25 crore. During the action, the contractor also deposited ₹46 lakh and said the remaining amount would be paid soon. Tent house firm also committed fraud According to GST officials, the investigation found irregularities in the documents of the catering and tent house company operating on the same premises. The firm's GST registration was cancelled in March 2026. It had not filed any returns since July 2025. Even so, it was carrying out business on a large scale. The firm had conducted business worth ₹2 crore to ₹2.5 crore from 2022-23 onwards. This is illegal, which is why action is being taken.

stories.title: 3 people missing in Sai river in Lucknow:Wives of 2 are pregnant; one married 2 years ago; went for Ganesh Visarjan
stories.summary: Three people went missing in the Sai River, which flows through Lucknow, on Tuesday evening. They had gone to immerse a Ganesh idol in the river. A crowd gathered at the spot as soon as people learnt about the incident. The SDRF, along with the police, reached the site after being informed. A search is underway for the three people who went missing in the river. The families of the three missing people are also present on the riverbank. Two of their wives are pregnant. The families allege that the SDRF team is searching in only one place. They say this is reducing the chances of finding them alive. The incident took place near the Jabraila bridge in Mohanlalganj. People from Sisendi village, 5 km away, had arrived here at 5 p.m. to immerse a Ganesh idol. A 35-year-old man named Dheeraj then went into the deeper part of the Sai River and began to drown. Forty-year-old Hariprasad entered the river to save him, but he too began drowning. During this, 22-year-old Pramod also entered the river. After that, there was no trace of the three men. Four pictures related to the incident- Three youths still missing after 6 hours Even by 11 p.m., around 6 hours after the incident, there was no trace of the three people. Anita, the wife of missing man Dheeraj, alleged that despite considerable time having passed, no net had been put in the river. A search operation is currently being conducted using one boat. The search does not appear to be progressing quickly. Six local divers and SDRF teams join the search The SDRF team is searching for all three people in the river. Six local divers are also involved in the search alongside the SDRF. The SDRF team reached the spot about 40 minutes after receiving information about the accident and began the search operation. The team includes around 20 constables, along with SI Ritesh Sachan. The team is searching for the people who drowned in the river using a boat, hooks, life jackets and other flood rescue equipment. A police team is also present at the spot. ADM FR, SDM Akash Singh and ACP RK Singh had also reached the spot. Families in turmoil, condition of both men's wives poor The families of Hariprasad and Dheeraj, who went missing in the Sai river, have been in turmoil since news of the accident emerged. Hariprasad's wife, Shyamawati, is pregnant. Their family has a 12-year-old son, Nihal, and a 10-year-old daughter, Nihalika. Meanwhile, Dheeraj married Anita around two years ago. Anita is also around three months pregnant. Dheeraj's mother, Deepa, is also part of the family. Pramod was a resident of Hira Kheda, which falls under Sisendi village. All three worked as labourers to support their families. Following the accident, the three families are in mourning, while their relatives sit by the river, hoping to find their loved ones. Police officers tried to reason with the people Family members present at the spot accused the police administration of delaying and being negligent in the search operation. Police officers explained the situation to them. An officer said, "Please do not worry. The SDRF team is searching in the direction of the river's current. They are highly experienced. No one is sitting idle. Everyone who is here is engaged in the operation."

stories.title: One accused in Agra foetal sex determination case absconding:4 of 5 arrested; Sonipat team raided with decoy pregnant woman
stories.summary: Action has been taken against five accused in connection with foetal sex determination testing at Sanskar Hospital and Trauma Centre in Itaura, Agra. Four of the accused have been arrested, while one remains absconding. Police are conducting a continuous search and search operation to arrest the absconding accused. A joint team from Sonipat and Agra is investigating the case. According to the chief medical officer, further action will be taken against the hospital and those found guilty based on the investigation report once it is submitted. A pregnant woman was used as a decoy to lay the trap The Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PCPNDT) team from Sonipat had laid a trap to catch the foetal sex determination gang. The team used a pregnant woman from Sonipat as a decoy and got her to contact members of the gang. She was made to speak to the gang members to obtain information about the sex of her unborn child. The gang members took the decoy woman to different locations throughout the day. At around 5 p.m., she was brought to Sanskar Hospital and Trauma Centre in Itaura. During this time, the team, which had been prepared in advance, raided the hospital and took action. Chinese wireless ultrasound machine seized During the raid, the team seized a Chinese-made portable wireless ultrasound machine. It has a wireless probe that does not need to be connected to the machine with a cable. An ultrasound can be performed by connecting a tablet or smartphone to the machine via Wi-Fi. The team took the machine into custody for examination. Hospital operating without registration According to CMO Dr Arun Srivastava, Sanskar Hospital and Trauma Centre was being run by Bhanu Pratap, a resident of Saiyan. The hospital was not registered. No doctor was found at the site either. The hospital was operating from three rooms. A board advertising an ICU facility had also been put up there. The investigation revealed that Bhanu and Pradeep had rented the building from Manju, a resident of Shamsabad, around two months ago. Sanskar Hospital and Trauma Centre was being run from the same building. It has also emerged that an application had been submitted to register the hospital. Hospital had operated from the building before The building in which the hospital was being run has three shops on its first floor. Boards stating that the shops were available for rent have been put up. It has emerged that a hospital had previously operated from the same building in the name of Thakur Das. Machine connected via Wi-Fi The portable ultrasound machine that was seized has a wireless probe. It does not need to be connected by wire. A tablet or smartphone is connected to the machine via Wi-Fi. An ultrasound can then be performed. Four arrested, search under way for one accused Five accused have been identified in the case. Four of them have been arrested, while one remains absconding. Police are conducting continuous raids to arrest him, and search operations are being carried out at possible hideouts. Teams from Sonipat and Agra are jointly investigating the entire case. According to the CMO, further action will be taken against the hospital and those found responsible in the case on the basis of the investigation report once it is released.

stories.title: Azamgarh man who killed wife, 2 priests shot dead:Held 3 children hostage; encounter followed after he shot one
stories.summary: Police killed in an encounter the man who had shot dead two priests and his wife in Azamgarh. The joint team of the Special Operations Group (SOG) and the Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) carried out the operation at around 1 a.m. late at night. Senior Superintendent of Police Dr Anil Kumar confirmed the accused's death at around 3:30 a.m. SSP Dr Anil Kumar said that after committing three murders, the accused had locked himself in a room with his three children and was repeatedly threatening to kill them. During this time, he fired a bullet at one of his children, injuring the child. After this, the accused began firing indiscriminately at the police. He was hit by a bullet in retaliatory firing by the police. He was taken to hospital, where doctors pronounced him dead. The SSP said that one child was in critical condition, while two children were out of danger. Shambhupur Gahji resident Arvind Singh reached home at around 6 p.m. on Tuesday. His wife, Babita Singh (40), mother Samla Devi (70), daughter Pari (five), son Lakkha (six) and seven-month-old daughter were at home at the time. In addition, Pandit Mahendra Pathak (60) from Patkhauli village, Akhilesh Mishra (55) from Chhitauna Bhatauli village, his son Himanshu Mishra and another priest were conducting a religious ritual. Arvind's wife Babita was conducting the religious ritual. After arriving home from the market and seeing this, Arvind questioned the priests. The priests told him that a ritual was being conducted. Arvind then began asking them for their Aadhaar cards. An argument subsequently broke out between Arvind and the priests. As the argument with the priests escalated, accused Arvind took his licensed rifle out of the room. He first shot his wife, Babita. He then opened fire on the two priests as well. Hearing the sound of gunfire, people from the surrounding area rushed to Arvind's house. Seeing the crowd entering the house, the accused, Arvind, locked himself in a room with three children. The neighbours immediately informed the police about the incident. The police then tried to persuade him for seven hours, but he did not relent.

stories.title: CM Yogi to inaugurate state women’s shelter today:Built in Gorakhpur at ₹8 crore cost; can house 100 women
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi will inaugurate the newly constructed building of the Government Women's Shelter Home in Gorakhpur today. He will then inspect the under-construction Government Observation Home (Juvenile). The Government Women's Shelter Home building has been constructed in Chargawan, near the Agriculture Department's seed warehouse, at a cost of ₹8 crore 5 lakh 42 thousand. The building has the capacity to accommodate 100 women. Along with accommodation, it also has other necessary facilities. The Government Women's Shelter is a protective and residential institution run under the Department of Women and Child Welfare. The primary objective behind establishing these shelters is to provide safe accommodation, protection and necessary support to women affected by domestic violence, in need, facing difficult circumstances, having lost their way or dealing with other social and family-related difficulties. Before inaugurating the state-run women's shelter, the Chief Minister will inspect the observation home under construction for juveniles. The State Observation Home (Juvenile) is being built in Chargawan, near the Agriculture Department's seed warehouse, at a cost of ₹14 crore 87 lakh. It will have accommodation for 100 juveniles. The campus will also have a separate block for the Juvenile Justice Board. Construction is expected to be completed by February 2027. Chief Minister to attend the seven-day Shrimad Bhagwat Katha at Gorakhnath Temple Chief Minister Yogi will also attend the inaugural programme of the seven-day Shrimad Bhagwat Katha at Gorakhnath Temple. The event is being organised to mark the 57th death anniversary of late Mahant Digvijaynath and the 12th death anniversary of late Mahant Avaidyanath. Storyteller Rajend Das, the head of Malookpeeth in Vrindavan, will narrate the Shrimad Bhagwat Katha to devotees.

stories.title: Teacher Nishat’s couple dance with colleague:Boyfriend angry after seeing them hold hands; killed her, died by suicide 16 days later in Lakhimpur
stories.summary: A video from a Teachers’ Day programme at Children’s Academy School in Lakhimpur Kheri has surfaced days after teacher Nishat Fatima was murdered at the school on September 21. The video shows Nishat performing a couple dance with her colleagues and appearing cheerful during the programme. Police probe past relationship and growing distance The video has raised questions about the events leading up to the murder. Police investigation has revealed details of an alleged past relationship between Nishat and Saud Ansari, as well as growing differences between the two in recent times. It has also been reported that Saud had watched the Teachers’ Day dance video. However, police are still investigating whether the video had any direct connection with the murder. See three pictures from the dance... Police probe Saud’s reaction to Nishat’s Teachers’ Day dance video Saud Ansari was reportedly upset by Nishat Fatima’s dance performance with a fellow teacher at the school’s Teachers’ Day programme. Nishat and Saud had allegedly been in a relationship for a long time, and their families had reportedly known each other for years. However, the two had grown distant over the past few months. Around this time, Saud began posting emotional messages on social media. Police are now investigating whether Saud had watched the Teachers’ Day dance video and, if so, what his reaction was afterwards. The possible connection between the video, his reaction and the subsequent events remains under investigation. Nishat and Saud’s families had known each other for around 10 years According to local residents, Nishat Fatima’s family had previously lived as tenants in a house owned by Saud Ansari’s family. As a result, the two families had known each other for around 10 years and remained in contact over the years. Nishat had been working as a teacher at Children’s Academy for around a year. Local residents said Saud would sometimes drop her at school and also pick her up after work. Teacher murdered at school as children and parents were nearby Saud Ansari allegedly murdered teacher Nishat Fatima and later died by suicide on September 21. As the school was conducting examinations that day, the premises were crowded with students and teachers. Panic spread after the shots were fired. The incident took place around the time the examination was ending, when many parents were waiting outside the school gate. Police personnel who arrived after the incident evacuated the building. The children were reportedly terrified and began crying when they saw their family members. Many left their lunch boxes and water bottles behind as they rushed out of the school. Case registered against Saud and his parents Police also registered a case against Saud Ansari, his father Qayum Ansari and his mother based on a complaint filed by Nishat’s brother. The complaint alleges that the family had pressured Nishat to marry Saud. How did the accused come in contact with the teacher, and why did he commit the crime? Read the full story in 4 points 1- Nishat’s family once rented Saud’s house, where their conversations began Saud Ansari lived in the Naurangabad area, while Nishat Fatima’s family lived in Hidayat Nagar, around 1 km away. Saud’s father, Qayum Ansari, works at the District Industries Office, while his elder brother, Dawood Ansari, runs a sofa and mattress shop. Saud had completed his B.Com and was pursuing a B.Ed. Nishat’s father, Iliyas, works in Mumbai. Her elder brother, Shadab Akhtar, is preparing for the PCS examination, while her younger brother, Anas, is also studying. The family originally belongs to Sultanpur and moved to Lakhimpur with Iliyas around 12 years ago. Initially, the family rented a house owned by Saud’s family. This was where Saud and Nishat first began talking. A few days later, Iliyas had a house constructed and the family moved there. However, Saud and Nishat continued to remain in contact. 2- Saud pressured Nishat to marry him despite her refusal Nishat travelled by auto every day to teach at Children’s Academy School in the Shahpura Kothi area. Local residents said that until a few months ago, Saud would sometimes drop her at school and pick her up on his motorcycle. However, the two had reportedly stopped speaking to each other in recent months. Nishat’s brother, Shadab, alleged that Saud frequently harassed his sister and pressured her to marry him, but she refused. He said the family had tried several times to reason with Saud and had also complained to his parents, but his behaviour did not improve. 3- Saud reached school with two pistols and confronted Nishat According to eyewitnesses, Saud arrived at Children’s Academy School on Monday morning carrying a bag containing two country-made pistols and five cartridges. Students were taking their examinations at the time. When the examination ended at around 11.30 am, Nishat was taking the children out through the school gate. Saud allegedly approached her and began speaking to her. An argument soon broke out between them, and the two continued arguing as they moved towards the first floor. A heated quarrel then took place in the corridor outside Room No. 11. According to the account, Saud took out the pistols and handed one of them to Nishat. 4- Saud threatened another teacher before shooting Nishat and himself Hearing the commotion, a Class 2 teacher rushed towards the corridor to help. Saud pointed a country-made pistol at her and threatened to kill anyone who intervened. The teacher then locked herself and the children inside a classroom for safety. When Nishat reportedly tried to escape, Saud opened fire at her. He then shot himself. Saud posted a final Instagram message minutes before his death Saud had been posting emotional and self-focused messages on his Instagram account for the past few months. Just minutes before his death, he posted an Instagram story referring to his possible death and asking people to delete his photographs and messages. In the post, he wrote: “Assalamu alaikum, everyone. If I die suddenly, I request all of you to remove my photographs from your phones and social media accounts. Delete my messages and report my Facebook account. Nothing in this world is permanent. Since we have come into this world, we will certainly have to leave it. After my death, please do not look at or post my photographs. Pray for me; InshaAllah, this will help me. Forgive me if I have hurt you, knowingly or unknowingly. When you hear that I am no longer alive, do not say or post ‘RIP’. I am a Muslim, so please say, ‘Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.’ I am proud to be a member of the ummah of Hazrat Muhammad (peace be upon him). Allah Hafiz!”

stories.title: Which side will educated UP youth lean?:Clear picture to come 3 months before Assembly polls; MLC election to show political mood for 2027
stories.summary: A month before the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, polls have been announced for 11 Legislative Council seats under the ‘Shikshak’ and ‘Snatak’ quotas. The contest is being viewed as a major 'litmus test' for the ruling BJP and the main opposition Samajwadi Party (SP). Both parties have been preparing to win these seats for the past year. Unlike a general election, the electorate here will comprise educated young people, 'Shikshak' and others who have been 'Snatak' for at least three years. The results could therefore indicate the political preferences of the state's educated and younger voters. Know the 11 seats going to polls Of the 11 Legislative Council seats for which elections have been announced, five are 'Snatak' seats and six are 'Shikshak' seats. More than 10 lakh voters to decide the contest More than 10 lakh voters will exercise their franchise in this 'mini-mandate'. To register as a 'Snatak' constituency voter, a person must have held a degree for at least three years. In the 'Shikshak' constituencies, only 'Shikshak' who are currently teaching can vote. Personal outreach, not rallies, will drive the campaign Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal says the format of this special Legislative Council election is very different from general elections. Roadshows and public rallies by senior leaders and ministers do not have much impact in these constituencies. Instead, personal outreach, messaging and political networks are the biggest tools. 'Shikshak' and 'Snatak' vote according to their own views and priorities. SP and independents have won in BJP strongholds The ruling party has some advantage in this election, but the results have also produced surprises in the past. In the 2020 MLC elections, the SP won the Varanasi 'Snatak' seat, despite Varanasi being Prime Minister Narendra Modi's parliamentary constituency. In the Gorakhpur-Faizabad 'Shikshak' seat, from Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's home region, the BJP did not field a candidate. The 'Shikshak' Group candidate won the seat. This is why neither party is taking any seat lightly. BJP has been preparing for MLC elections for a year BJP spokesperson Sameer Singh says the party began preparing for the Legislative Council elections a year ago. The BJP has already announced candidates for five seats, while candidates for the remaining seats will be announced soon. Singh says the BJP will win more seats this time and claims that young people, 'Shikshak' and women are all with the party. He says these groups will teach the SP a lesson. Meanwhile, SP MLC and candidate from the Allahabad-Jhansi 'Snatak' constituency, Dr Man Singh Yadav, says the election will be a contest between the public and the SP on one side and the BJP on the other. He describes it as an election of educated voters and alleges that the BJP shut 26,000 schools and irregularities took place in the recruitment of 69,000 'Shikshak'. What impact will it have on the 2027 election? Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal says the election is not merely a way to elect 11 MLCs but will also help shape the political atmosphere ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. According to him, if the BJP increases its number of seats, it will send a message that the state's educated youth and 'Shikshak' are satisfied with the Yogi government's policies. If the SP gains an advantage in these constituencies, it would gain a psychological boost just before the 2027 election. The results will also give both parties an opportunity to identify their shortcomings and fine-tune their election strategies over the next two months. SP fields candidates on all seats, BJP and Congress announce five each

stories.title: Owaisi seeks alliance, SP-Congress call him ‘vote katwa’:Fear of split in Muslim votes or bid to protect secular image; what will AIMIM do now?
stories.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi has held five public meetings in Uttar Pradesh since June 2026. After rallies in Bahraich, Bijnor, Saharanpur and Moradabad, he addressed a rally in Kanpur on September 20. While his speeches drew applause from supporters, strong opposition to him has also begun to emerge. The Samajwadi Party and Congress have called him a 'vote cutter' and 'BJP's B-team'. Congress MP Imran Masood says Owaisi's decision to contest the Uttar Pradesh elections will benefit the BJP. Meanwhile, SP MLA Hasan Rumi and former SP MLA Irfan Solanki say Owaisi has failed to understand Uttar Pradesh's political mood. The question now is whether the opposition to Owaisi is merely a political attack or whether it stems from the fear of a split in Muslim votes. Read the full report... Congress says defeating BJP with Muslim votes alone is impossible Congress MP from Saharanpur Imran Masood says the Opposition's main objective is to remove the BJP from power. However, he said this cannot be achieved on the strength of Muslim votes alone. He said, The political atmosphere in Telangana and Uttar Pradesh is completely different. Even if Owaisi wins 4-5 seats through his rhetoric, ultimately it will be the BJP that forms the government. When the BJP comes to power, Muslims suffer the biggest loss. SP alleges Owaisi received a 'package' from BJP SP leaders have also taken a strong stand against Owaisi. Kanpur Cantt MLA Hasan Rumi made a serious allegation, saying that whenever efforts are made to strengthen Muslims, AIMIM is brought into the fray after being given a 'package' by the BJP. He said Owaisi's politics had already been exposed in Bihar and West Bengal. In Bengal, he sought votes in the name of Babri but then disappeared from the scene, he alleged. Expert says Muslim community also has doubts about Owaisi According to senior journalist and Muslim affairs expert Naved Shikoh, the possibility of Muslim votes getting divided because Owaisi entered into the electoral field cannot be ruled out. In the 2022 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Owaisi's AIMIM claimed to have fielded candidates in 100 seats. The party secured around 0.43% of the votes and did not win a single seat. After the experience of Maharashtra and Bihar, sections of the Muslim community in Uttar Pradesh are also looking at Owaisi with suspicion, Shikoh said. A sizeable section believes that he has entered the fray mainly to cut into the SP-Congress vote, he added. Owaisi's entire focus on western UP After its poor performance in 2022, AIMIM has made a major change to its strategy this time. Instead of merely contesting elections, the party is focusing on strengthening its organisation. The party launched its election preparations from Bahraich in June 2026. Owaisi's particular focus is on Muslim-majority districts in western Uttar Pradesh, including Saharanpur, Moradabad, Bijnor, Muzaffarnagar, Rampur and Amroha. At his Kanpur rally, Owaisi adopted a relatively softer stance towards Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) chief Jayant Chaudhary. Although the RLD is currently allied with the BJP, Owaisi's approach is being seen as an attempt to work around the political equations in western UP. What will Owaisi do if SP-Congress refuse to join hands? Aseem Waqar, who left Owaisi and joined the Congress, said, On the one hand, Owaisi calls the SP and Congress enemies of Muslims, and on the other, he pleads with them to join hands. How can these two things happen at the same time? According to political analysts, the deadline set by Owaisi is unlikely to have any impact on the SP and Congress. This leaves Owaisi with three options: SP says it keeps away from extremism SP spokesperson Mohammad Azam says the party maintains equal distance from all forms of extremism. He said alliances are not formed through statements made from rally stages; they are decided through discussions between the top leaderships of the parties. Statements made from the stage, he said, are merely political rhetoric. AIMIM spokesperson Shadab Chauhan said, We are not begging for seats. We are talking about respect and our share. In Bihar, Congress and RJD were arrogant. We had asked for six seats, but they did not give them to us. We won five seats and showed them. In UP too, talks are not happening because of Akhilesh Yadav's arrogance. Our fight is against the BJP, but we will not become anyone's sidekick at the cost of our existence. SP-Congress keeping a close watch on Owaisi's every move Senior journalist Naved Shikoh says gathering crowds at Owaisi's rallies is one thing, but converting that support into votes is another. The Muslim voter in Uttar Pradesh has now become very cautious, he said. According to him, voters are aware that the direct contest in the state is between the SP-Congress alliance and the BJP. He said, If Owaisi fields candidates in 200 seats, they may not win, but by cutting 2,000 to 5,000 votes, they could certainly upset the SP-Congress's prospects in 20 to 25 seats. This is why the SP and Congress are keeping a close watch on Owaisi's every move.

stories.title: MLC elections from MLA quota likely soon:10 seats fall vacant in January; polls may be held 2 months early due to Model Code
stories.summary: Elections to 10 Legislative Council seats under the MLA quota may be held in November-December. The terms of the sitting members are set to end on January 30. With the Model Code of Conduct likely to come into force in January because of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the elections to these seats could be held one or two months earlier instead. The Election Commission has already announced elections in October for 11 seats under the teachers' and graduates' constituencies. An official from the Chief Electoral Officer's office said MLAs vote to elect members to the Legislative Council seats that are falling vacant in January. The Model Code of Conduct is likely to come into force in the first or second week of January ahead of the Assembly elections. In such a situation, MLAs would not be able to vote. Therefore, the elections are likely to be held in November-December so that the existing MLAs can elect the new members. At present, the BJP has the numbers required to win eight MLC seats. The party is therefore likely to seek elections to these seats before the Model Code of Conduct comes into force. BJP to lose one seat, SP set to gain Elections to the 10 seats falling vacant were held in January 2021. At that time, the BJP had 304 MLAs and the Samajwadi Party had 47. A candidate needed the support of 31 MLAs to win one seat. Based on this strength, the BJP won nine seats and the SP one. At present, the BJP has 256 MLAs, and the SP has 101. If the 33 MLAs of the BJP's alliance partners, three unaffiliated MLAs and two MLAs of Raja Bhaiya's Jansatta Dal Loktantrik are also included, the total comes to 294. Based on this strength, the BJP is set to win eight seats and the SP two. The Bahujan Samaj Party does not have a single MLA in the Assembly. Therefore, its candidate would not even be able to file a nomination without the support of either the BJP or the SP. BJP preparing to field 2-3 time MLCs in Assembly elections According to BJP sources, central leaders have reached a consensus that workers who have already served two or three terms as members of the Legislative Council or Rajya Sabha should not be given another term. Instead, they should be given a chance to contest Assembly and Lok Sabha elections. The BJP has previously fielded national general secretary Bhupendra Yadav from Rajasthan's Alwar and former Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan from Odisha's Sambalpur in Lok Sabha elections. A party functionary said that if the same formula is applied to the Legislative Council elections, several senior leaders may have to contest Assembly elections to remain members of the legislature. Now, know which faces could get another chance... Kunwar Manvendra Singh Kunwar Manvendra Singh is serving his second term as a member of the Legislative Council. He was earlier a member from 2000 to 2006. He is currently also the Chairman of the Legislative Council. Manvendra served as an MLA from the Garautha seat in Jhansi from 1985 to 1989. He is around 74 years old. The decision on whether the party will give him another term or promote a young member of his family will be taken at Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's level. Swatantra Dev Singh Jal Shakti Minister Swatantra Dev Singh is a member of the Legislative Council for the third time. He first served as an MLC from 2004 to 2010 and then from 2017 to 2021. Swatantra Dev Singh is considered a senior party leader and has a strong hold among the Kurmi community. The party may field him from a Kurmi-dominated seat in Bundelkhand in the upcoming Assembly elections. However, the final decision will be taken by the state and central leadership. Arvind Sharma Energy Minister Arvind Kumar Sharma became an MLC for the first time in 2021. Sharma is from Mau district, which has a sizeable Bhumihar population. A close aide of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the decision on whether Sharma will be sent to the Legislative Council again or fielded in an election will be taken at the Prime Minister's Office level. However, as Sharma is serving his first term as an MLC, the party may give him another opportunity. Dharampal Prajapati Minister of State (Independent Charge) Dharampal Prajapati is also serving his second term as an MLC. He was first made an MLC in 2017. In September 2021, he was inducted as a Minister of State during the second cabinet expansion of the Yogi Adityanath government's first term. In the Yogi government's second term, he was again made Minister of State for Home Guards. Given his influence among the Prajapati (Kumhar) community, Dharampal could be made a Legislative Council member for a third term. However, there is also speculation that he could be fielded from a seat in the Braj region. Ashwini Tyagi Former BJP state minister Ashwini Tyagi is serving his first term as a member of the Legislative Council. He was sent to the Council with the backing of Cabinet Minister Swatantra Dev Singh and former organisational general secretary Sunil Bansal. During the Lok Sabha elections, he was made in-charge of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's constituency, Varanasi. Modi won the election, but his victory margin fell significantly. Tyagi currently holds no position in the central or state BJP teams. The party is considering replacing him with state minister Basant Tyagi as a Legislative Council member. Govind Narayan Shukla Former state general secretary Govind Narayan Shukla became a member of the Legislative Council for the first time in 2021. Shukla had continuously held a position in the BJP's state team since 2014. Although he did not find a place in the state team this time, he was made in-charge of the state party headquarters because of his experience. He is considered close to national general secretary (organisation) BL Santosh and also has good relations with state general secretary (organisation) Dharampal Singh. As a result, Shukla could be given another opportunity. Salil Bishnoi Former BJP state vice-president Salil Bishnoi did not find a place in Pankaj Chaudhary's team. He is serving his second term as an MLC. He has also contested elections from Kanpur's Aryanagar and Sisamau seats but lost both times. Party sources believe Bishnoi may be dropped this time and a new face could be given an opportunity. Dharmendra Singh Dr Dharmendra Singh has been appointed as the party's state vice-president for a second consecutive term. In 2021, he was the BJP's Gorakhpur region president. It was during that period that he was made an MLC with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's backing. Given his proximity to CM Yogi, Dharmendra Singh could be given another opportunity. Surendra Chaudhary Surendra Chaudhary became an MLC in 2021 with the backing of Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya. In the 2017 Assembly elections, the BJP had given him a ticket from Prayagraj's Soraon seat. However, following an alliance with Apna Dal, the seat went to the ally and Chaudhary had to withdraw his nomination

stories.title: Karni Sena youth district chief chased and beaten in Aligarh:Crowd slapped him, hit him with belts and made him chant ‘Jai Bhim’
stories.summary: A mob attacked Sachin Raghav, district president of the Kshatriya Yuva Karni Sena, in Aligarh. They chased him down the road, slapping him and hitting him with belts. During the assault, Sachin was seen pleading for forgiveness with folded hands. His younger brother and his brother's friend, who came to rescue him, were also beaten and injured. The attackers dragged Sachin inside Ambedkar Park. There, they made him raise slogans in honour of the Valmiki community and Dr Ambedkar. The attackers fled the scene as soon as they saw the police arrive following the report of the incident. The police sent Sachin to a government hospital for a medical examination. The incident took place at Ghantaghar intersection in the Civil Lines area. See two pictures... Sachin Raghav was eating chaat with his younger brother At around 6.30 p.m. on Wednesday, Sachin Raghav, the district president of the Kshatriya Yuva Karni Sena, was eating chaat near the Clock Tower. His younger brother Sundar and a friend were with him. Meanwhile, a mob of around 50 youths surrounded the two brothers. Chanting "Jai Bhim", the mob began beating Sachin. They attacked him with slaps and belts. When his brother tried to save him, they beat him too. Sachin said, “The attackers dragged me along the road from Ambedkar Park towards the SBI intersection. During this, they beat me with belts. The attackers also assaulted me inside the park.”

stories.title: 19-year-old Al-Qaeda-linked terrorist arrested:Used Instagram and WhatsApp to recruit ‘mujahids’, UP ATS nabs him in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh ATS has arrested an al-Qaeda-linked terrorist from Coimbatore in Tamil Nadu. According to the ATS, 19-year-old Maqsood Ali was in contact with handlers based in Pakistan. He was involved in a conspiracy to carry out violent anti-national activities. He was recruiting young people into a radical ideology and preparing them to become mujahideen. Maqsood is originally from Madhwapur village in Siddharthnagar. After his arrest, the ATS brought him to Lucknow on transit remand. He was produced in court, and further legal proceedings are under way. He recruited young people through social media The Uttar Pradesh ATS claims that Maqsood had created groups on different social media platforms. Through these groups, he was recruiting young people for anti-national activities. He was influencing people with a radical ideology and turning them into mujahideen. He was also raising funds for this purpose so that they could receive training in the use of modern weapons. According to the ATS, the investigation also revealed that the module's links extended beyond other states in the country to suspected individuals based abroad. Was in contact with Pakistani handlers According to the ATS, Maqsood was developing hacking tools while staying in contact with handlers based in Pakistan. During questioning, he said that he had learnt about Python, Java, coding and hacking through online sources. Maqsood acquired technical information through Instagram, YouTube, Telegram and various WhatsApp groups. Created an application called 'Captain M Network' The investigation also found that Maqsood had developed a secure application called 'Captain M Network' to further his objective. Its purpose was to connect people through a platform. The ATS claims that Nabeel, Maqsood and others were in contact with one another through it. The investigation also uncovered details of several WhatsApp groups linked to Maqsood. These included groups named UU Entry Gate, United Ummah, Ghazwa-e-Hind, Team Black Hat and Lashkar-e-Mahdi. According to the ATS, suspects using Pakistani numbers and other Pakistani hackers were also members of these groups. Maqsood was also linked to Nabeel's group According to the ATS, Maqsood was also linked to a WhatsApp group called 'La Ghalib-Illallah', created by Mohammad Nabeel. Literature related to the banned terrorist organisation Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) and videos on bomb-making were being shared in the group. The ATS is now investigating Maqsood's digital network, foreign contacts, online activities and the role of other people linked through him. Nabeel was arrested in Azamgarh on 12 September The ATS arrested 19-year-old Mohammad Nabeel in Azamgarh on 12 September. He, too, is accused of spreading AQIS ideology and recruiting young people through social media. He was trying to influence young people with terrorist ideology through various WhatsApp groups. ATS officials had said that an investigation of Nabeel's mobile phone revealed information about a WhatsApp group involved in propagating AQIS ideology. One group's name is in Arabic. The ATS claims that people in the group were addressed as "mujahids".

stories.title: SP appoints new district presidents in 6 districts:Jai Singh in Ayodhya, Sunil Kumar Maurya in Ballia; full list
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party announced the names of new district presidents in 6 Uttar Pradesh districts on Wednesday evening. The party leadership believes that assigning responsibility to new faces will bring fresh energy to the SP organisation. It will also help consolidate the vote bank at the local level. The names of the district presidents for Ayodhya, Ballia, Banda, Pilibhit, Gautam Buddh Nagar and Unnao were released after national president Akhilesh Yadav gave the go-ahead. Just a few days ago, the party had said that separate manifestos would be prepared for each district. Who has been given charge of which district? Read the full list... Caste balance taken into consideration in the list The Samajwadi Party leadership has made this reshuffle entirely keeping the electoral equations and caste balance in mind. The new district presidents will not only be responsible for strengthening the organisation down to the booth level, but will also have the primary responsibility of increasing the Samajwadi Party's support base in the 2027 Assembly election by coordinating among party workers. For the first time, a separate manifesto will be prepared for every district The Samajwadi Party's new strategy is aimed directly at building local-level engagement with voters. Instead of telling people during the election, "What will we do across the state?", the party will now speak directly about "What new things will we bring to your district?" The party's top leadership believes that Purvanchal, western Uttar Pradesh, Awadh and Bundelkhand each face different grassroots challenges. A common manifesto can accommodate only major state-level issues, leaving local concerns out. People will feel connected to the party only when the manifesto mentions basic problems in their areas, such as roads, water, electricity, healthcare, education and employment. Suggestion made at strategy meeting; Akhilesh approves it A high-level strategy meeting of all district presidents and office-bearers was held around two months ago in the presence of Akhilesh Yadav. The meeting saw a suggestion to include district-level issues in the manifesto, with the benefits of the move also being outlined. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav immediately gave the proposal the go-ahead. Following this, SP state president Shyamlal Pal issued a directive to all district presidents and office-bearers, asking them to prepare a complete account of their respective areas. The party leadership has asked all district presidents to prepare reports on the five biggest problems in their respective areas, stalled projects, and local employment opportunities.

stories.title: SP leader’s body placed on highway, barricades broken:‘Hang killers’ slogans raised in Prayagraj; family seeks govt job, ₹2 crore compensation
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Pawan Yadav was murdered in Prayagraj on Tuesday. After the body reached home following the post-mortem at 4 p.m. on Wednesday evening, people erupted in anger. Hundreds of people gathered, placed the body on the road and blocked the Varanasi-Prayagraj National Highway. This led to long queues of vehicles on the highway and brought traffic to a complete standstill. During the protest, people raised slogans including "Down with the police administration" and "Hang the killers". The situation became more tense when the protesters broke through the police barricades placed on the highway. Some people also uprooted and threw away boards installed at the spot. As soon as they received the information, a team of police and administrative officials reached the spot and began trying to persuade the people. Amid the uproar, which continued for a long time, the officials assured them that strict action would be taken against the accused. At present, around 200 police personnel, 10 ACPs, forces from nine police stations and five PAC vehicles are deployed at the spot. Talks are under way with the body placed on the ground. The family members and villagers are insisting that the district magistrate be called. They are seeking a written assurance. They are insisting on a job for one member of the family and compensation of ₹2 crore. See 4 pictures... Two accused were shot in a police encounter in the afternoon Earlier, on Wednesday afternoon, police searching for the accused had an encounter with history-sheeters Lalla Yadav and Nihal in the Baraut area of Handia police station limits. Both sustained bullet wounds to their legs. Police arrested the two injured men along with the village head's husband and one other accused, taking the total number of arrests to four. Injured Lalla Yadav and Nihal have been admitted to the CHC in Handia. Meanwhile, the other arrested accused are being questioned. Police officers said all aspects related to the murder are being investigated. The police are also investigating the recovery of weapons and other evidence from the accused. Jitendra Yadav, alias Lalla, is a resident of Mugraon in the Handia police station area. More than 12 cases have been registered against him at several police stations in the district under serious charges, including murder, attempt to murder and robbery. According to police sources, Lalla was the one who shot Pawan Yadav. According to the police, the attackers arrived on a motorcycle. The youth sitting pillion shot Pawan. The investigation also revealed a possible old enmity. The police took action after examining footage from 42 CCTV cameras. A video has also emerged showing the attackers on the motorcycle. Based on this, the police detained Lalla Yadav, Brijesh Yadav and Nihal Ali. During questioning, it emerged that the three had arrived on a motorcycle to carry out the crime. Nihal was riding the motorcycle. Brijesh was seated in the middle and Lalla at the back. Lalla Yadav opened fire on Pawan Yadav. The motorcycle used in the incident and two country-made pistols have also been recovered. Both country-made pistols and the cartridges had been bought for ₹20,000. During questioning, it emerged that Pawan and Lalla had an old feud. Younger brother says: Bulldozers should be run over the accused's homes Pawan's younger brother, Brijesh Yadav, said, "Our elder brother has been murdered. When he left home, someone had called him. I do not know how he went to that place today when he did not usually go there. My brother had no enmity with anyone. He was a political figure. We now want justice. All those who are responsible for the murder and are roaming freely should be given the strictest punishment. Their homes should be bulldozed." SP spokesperson says, ‘Jungle raj in the state’ SP national spokesperson Nidhi Yadav said, "Today, you can see how such a major incident was carried out in Allahabad. Handia town is a bustling area. The president of the association of former village heads was murdered there in broad daylight. There is jungle raj in this state. This government cannot ensure anyone's safety." Now read the full details Pawan Yadav, who lives in Mugrawan village, had previously served as the village head. He is currently the Samajwadi Party's district secretary. Pawan was the youngest of two brothers. His family includes his wife, Neetu, three daughters-Khushi, Muskaan and Chhoti-and a son, Prince. At around 3 p.m. on Tuesday, Pawan reached Handia town in his car. He parked the car by the roadside in the Karmanasha locality. He then went to a nearby café to speak with friends. Around two hours later, at about 5:20 p.m., Pawan came out of the café and walked towards his car. As he was about to get into it, three assailants on a motorcycle arrived from the Prayagraj side. Two of the assailants were wearing helmets. The assailants slowed the motorcycle near Pawan's car. The pillion rider fired at Pawan from close range. The bullet hit him in the back. He fell bleeding onto the road as soon as he was shot. The sound of gunfire caused panic among people nearby. The entire incident took place around 500 metres from the police station. After receiving the information, police reached the spot and the injured Pawan was taken to a private hospital in Handia town. As his condition was serious, he was taken to a private hospital in Tagore, from where doctors referred him to SRN. Doctors there declared him dead.

stories.title: Yogi promises 1 lakh government jobs before election:Work will start on 19 September, says 9.5 lakh jobs already given
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is in Gorakhpur on Wednesday. He said, "We will provide government jobs to 1 lakh people in the next 6 months, before the Assembly election is announced. We are going to start this work on 19 September. s have already been issued for the recruitment of thousands of teachers in government schools." "We have previously provided jobs to 9.5 lakh people. Before 2017, whenever vacancies were announced, the Saifai syndicate would get to work collecting money. No young person got a job. There was bargaining, and people had to go to court. Loot, extortion and lawlessness were part of their twisted mindset." Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended 2 programmes in Gorakhpur. First- he inaugurated the Indian Medical Association's charitable blood centre in the morning. He said, "At one time, Uttar Pradesh bore a blot on its image. A dreaded mafia figure led each district. Encephalitis, too, has been eradicated like the mafia and mosquitoes. Today, there is one medical college in every district. There are 75 districts today, but 85 medical colleges." Second- At 4 p.m., Yogi inaugurated the Kalyan Mandapam built by the Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA). It cost ₹3 crore 9 lakh to construct. The halls on the ground and first floors can accommodate 300 people. It can be booked at affordable rates for weddings and other events. See 2 pictures... Yogi said: Uttar Pradesh is now free of curfews and riots At the inauguration of the Kalyan Mandapam, Yogi said, "Today, Uttar Pradesh is free from curfews and riots. Criminals are either in jail or have departed for the other world. No one can now issue threats openly or commit crimes. Everyone is safe, and there is a guarantee of security for everyone." He said, “Did anyone ever think that Ramgarh Tal would become so beautiful? It is attracting the country and the world. It used to be dirty. In reality, this dirt and disease did not belong to Gorakhpur; they were the result of the dirty mindset of the Samajwadi Party-Congress governments. There was dirt and crime, and no one had access to any facilities. Today, everyone is receiving facilities.”

stories.title: Kanpur govt hospital doctor’s driver treats patients:Prescribes medicines, tells them to buy outside; CMS warns of FIR
stories.summary: A case of endangering patients' lives has come to light at a government hospital in Kanpur. Dr Ramkesh, posted as the emergency medical officer, had gone to court to attend a hearing. His driver then began prescribing medicines to patients. The driver first placed a chair next to the doctor's in the OPD. He then began calling patients in one by one. He asked them about their illnesses and wrote medicines on their prescriptions. When patients asked him whether the medicines would be available at the hospital, the driver said they would have to buy them outside. A video of the incident, which took place on Monday, surfaced at around 2.30 p.m. on Wednesday. Following this, Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) Dr Piyush Mishra sought an explanation from Dr Ramkesh. He also warned that an FIR would be filed if it happened again. No outsider found during CMS inspection Dr Piyush Mishra, CMS of Kanshiram Hospital, said, "I learnt about the video on Monday evening. The hospital was inspected on Tuesday morning, but no outsider was found there. Dr Ramkesh was also questioned about the matter. The doctor said he had gone to provide court evidence. The person writing the prescriptions at the time was probably his driver, Dev." "Give an explanation or we will file an FIR" CMS Dr Piyush Mishra said that Dr Ramkesh must provide an explanation in the matter. If he fails to do so, an FIR will be registered against him. He warned that if an outsider is again found prescribing medicines to patients in the hospital or OPD in place of a doctor, action will also be taken against the doctor. The government will be informed about the entire matter. People say someone could lose their life Questions are being raised over the hospital administration's conduct after a video emerged showing a driver prescribing medicines to patients at a government hospital instead of a doctor. Several people said that patients rely on doctors for treatment. In such a situation, prescribing medicines to them by an outsider could even cost them their lives. It will become clear only after the investigation and the doctor's response whether the person shown in the video is actually the driver, Dev. Who had allowed him to prescribe medicines to patients? Know about Kanshiram Hospital Kanshi Ram Joint Hospital and Trauma Centre is located along the highway in Kanpur's Ramadevi area. In addition to providing general treatment, it also receives patients involved in accidents. People injured in accidents on the highway are also brought to the hospital. In February 2026, the Director-General of Health inspected the hospital and stressed the need to increase staff and improve healthcare services. During the district magistrate's inspection in May 2025, 64 employees were found absent from duty among the hospital's approximately 200 medical staff.

stories.title: Ashish Patel says Sanjay Nishad’s pain needs treatment:On Mata Prasad’s meeting, says ‘Perhaps he went to get medicine’
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh minister Ashish Patel issued a major statement on Wednesday regarding Sanjay Nishad's meeting with Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey. Speaking in Gonda, he said that if someone is in pain, they will certainly seek medicine. He added that he did not have medicine for Sanjay Nishad's pain. Ashish Patel said, "Where can I bring medicine for Sanjay Nishad's pain?" He also said, "If someone is in pain, they should be treated." The previous day, on Tuesday evening, Ashish Patel himself had met minister Sanjay Nishad. Read the three key points from minister Ashish Patel's statement 1. No kind of murder can be justified On the Vinod Sahani murder case, Ashish Patel said, "No kind of murder can be justified." He said, "The government stands firmly with the victim's family." Minister Sanjay Nishad had also staged a protest over the matter and demanded action. 2. There is nothing wrong with standing up against wrongdoing On Sanjay Nishad's protest, Ashish Patel said, "If someone is being wronged and another person stands up against it, that cannot be called wrong." He said, "Action has been taken in the Vinod Sahani murder case. The government stands with the victim. Strong security will be provided." 3. On the AI video, he said, "There should be political decorum" On Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav showing an artificial intelligence (AI) video of Chief Minister Yogi, Ashish Patel said, "He does not support this kind of politics. Irrespective of which side one is on, there is a certain decorum in politics. It should be followed." Minister Sanjay Nishad met Mata Prasad on 14 September Uttar Pradesh cabinet minister Sanjay Nishad met Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey on 14 September. Sanjay Nishad visited the Samajwadi Party leader's residence in Lucknow. He presented him with a bouquet. He posted a photograph of the meeting on social media with the caption: "A courtesy meeting. Discussed various issues." Sanjay Nishad had said about the meeting, "When the Samajwadi Party shut its door, we joined the BJP. Now, if the BJP also shuts its door, we will consider other options. We will remain with whoever resolves the issues of the Nishad community." At a meeting with officials in Gonda, Ashish Patel reviewed the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' being conducted on the occasion of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's birthday. He directed officials to organise programmes related to the campaign more effectively. A core committee meeting was held at the circuit house from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. on Wednesday. During the meeting, the minister asked officials to work in coordination with one another. The campaign and other administrative matters related to the district were discussed. Ashish Patel had met Minister Sanjay Nishad a day earlier Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad met Technical Education Minister Ashish Patel on Tuesday evening. Ashish Patel himself had gone to Sanjay Nishad's official residence to meet him. Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar about his meeting with Ashish Patel, Minister Nishad had said: "We have decided that the alliance partners will hold a meeting with Uttar Pradesh BJP in-charge Vinod Tawde. We will resolve minor issues, including Nishad reservation, officers not spending the budget on time and the issue of the recruitment of 69,000 teachers. There is no issue over the seats. We should make do with the seats we have received." Minister Nishad had said, "Wherever we contest, the BJP will ask its workers to coordinate with the alliance partners. If there is coordination at the booth level, it will become clear how strong we are. It has been the BJP's tradition for its state in-charges to coordinate with alliance partners and take stock of the ground situation. The seat-sharing arrangement is finalised after that. A meeting with the alliance partners may be held next week." Minister says: Nishad reservation issue needs to be resolved Minister Nishad had said, "We are going to hold a major rally in Allahabad. I have spoken to Ashish Patel to decide the venue. He has held an event there before, so I asked him to suggest a suitable ground. I will hold 10 major rallies across the state. I have also spoken to BJP organisation minister Dharampal." I told him on the issue of Nishad reservation that his party had included it in its agenda. When we joined the BJP, the agreement stated that reservation would be implemented after consideration. Chief Minister Yogi has raised the issue several times in the Assembly. The BJP suffered losses in Uttar Pradesh in 2024. Therefore, the issue should be resolved. The Nishad community was improperly included in the OBC category. Our community is landless, so people should be given land leases. The BSP had taken away the Nishads' livelihoods. Opposition parties create bitterness among the lower strata and foment caste conflict. Sanjay Nishad wrote: Our joint efforts will continue to move forward After the meeting, Sanjay Nishad wrote on X: “Today, I met Ashish Patel, an NDA ally and a Cabinet minister in the Uttar Pradesh government, at his residence in Lucknow. We discussed the government schemes currently being implemented in the state, social representation and issues of public interest. We also discussed improving coordination between the two parties down to the booth level and strengthening the organisation.” “Our shared resolve is to work for the development of the poor, deprived and backward sections. The focus will be on securing a better future for young people, social justice and the rights of every individual. These efforts will continue in the future to build a stronger society, a stronger organisation and a developed Uttar Pradesh.”

stories.title: Ramdev’s company files ₹50-crore defamation suit against Brij Bhushan:Called Patanjali ghee fake; company says brand value hit
stories.summary: Baba Ramdev's company has filed a ₹50 crore defamation case against former BJP MP from Kaiserganj in Gonda, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh. The Madhya Pradesh High Court heard the case on Tuesday (15 September). Brij Bhushan's lawyer sought more time from the court to file a response. The court has scheduled the next hearing for 18 September. The case relates to Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh calling Patanjali's products, particularly its desi ghee, counterfeit. In 2022, Brij Bhushan had called Patanjali's ghee "counterfeit" at a public event and appealed to people to keep a cow or buffalo at home. His statement had led to a dispute between Baba Ramdev and Brij Bhushan at the time. Patanjali's lawyer says: Statement affected share price Advocate Vikram Malviya appeared in court on behalf of Patanjali Foods. He said the former MP's statement damaged the company's brand image. He also claimed that the company's share price was affected following the controversial statement. This caused the company financial losses. Case reaches High Court from district court Patanjali Foods' registered office is in Vijay Nagar, Indore. Therefore, the claim was first filed in the Indore District Court. The initial hearing in the case took place in the district court. The court issued notices to Brij Bhushan. The case later reached the trial stage. A dispute over the electronic evidence arose during the proceedings. The case reached the High Court over this evidence. In the High Court, the company also submitted documents related to the electronic evidence and cited earlier Supreme Court orders. At the previous hearing, the court had sought a response from Brij Bhushan in the case. During Tuesday's hearing, a lawyer representing the former MP appeared in court and sought time to file a response. Patanjali has already been fined over its ghee It may be recalled that in 2025, the Food Safety Department in Pithoragarh fined Patanjali after its ghee was found not to meet the prescribed standards. In 2020, the Food Safety Department in Pithoragarh had collected a sample of Patanjali's ghee for testing. The sample failed the initial test. The company then sent the sample for a second test. However, the ghee was again found not to meet the prescribed standards. A case was subsequently filed in court. The court then imposed a fine of ₹1 lakh on Patanjali. The feud between Baba Ramdev and Brij Bhushan has been going on for a long time Brij Bhushan's feud with Baba Ramdev dates back a long time. On 17 August last year, Brij Bhushan said in Balrampur, "Ramdev is one-eyed. The person in whose name he is earning his livelihood, Maharishi Patanjali, also has a history rooted here in Gonda." However, he later apologised for the remark. Explaining himself, Brij Bhushan had said, "I made a statement during the Lok Sabha elections. After that, Acharya Balkrishna Bhatt called me and said I was a fool. We also responded in kind, and that is when our dispute began. In Balrampur, I was explaining the history of Gonda, Balrampur and the Devipatan division." During this, Maharishi Patanjali was mentioned. I remembered that when Baba Ramdev had set out on his Swadeshi Yatra, he had mentioned the birthplace of Maharishi Patanjali in Gonda and promised to develop it. He had made this promise to the public. In that context, I remembered Baba Ramdev. A few words came out of my mouth. I later realised that I should not have said that. This happened about eight months ago. Brij Bhushan saw the pimples on a student's face, held his hand and stopped him. He asked him why he had so many pimples on his face. "This is fake oil that is coming out, understand? This is Ramdev's ghee coming out." People began laughing as soon as they heard Brij Bhushan make this statement from the stage. He had earlier also commented on fake ghee On 24 November 2022, while he was a Member of Parliament, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh said at a religious discourse tent in Barabanki, “If there is no disease in the body, no one is richer than that person. A weak person's child is born weak. A healthy person's child is born healthy. To remain healthy, it is essential to maintain cleanliness at home and have milk and ghee. Milk is easily available in villages. I, too, used to go out grazing buffaloes. Only by keeping buffaloes and cows will you get pure milk and ghee. Otherwise, you will have to eat Ramdev's counterfeit ghee.”

stories.title: Man runs car over girlfriend in Lucknow:Drives off with her clinging onto bonnet; caught with another woman
stories.summary: A hit-and-run case has emerged from Lucknow, where a car driver hit a girl, causing her to get dragged onto the bonnet. Despite her screaming, the accused refused to stop the car. After driving forward for 20 to 25 meters, he accelerated, causing the girl to fall onto the road before running over her and fleeing the scene. The incident took place on Wednesday near Janeshwar Mishra Park in Gomti Nagar Extension, and video footage of the event has surfaced. Fortunately, the girl narrowly survived; she sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital. The injured girl has been identified as Anamika, and the accused as Shahnawaz, both residents of Lucknow. Anamika is reported to be Shahnawaz's girlfriend. According to the police, Anamika caught Shahnawaz with a new girlfriend, which led to an argument between them. When Shahnawaz attempted to drive away, Anamika stood in front of the car to block him, after which Shahnawaz tried to kill her. Anamika alleges that Shahnawaz had trapped her by concealing his identity under the fake name Yash Thakur. Police have arrested Shahnawaz and registered a case against him for attempted murder. It is being reported that Shahnawaz had been in an affair with Anamika for a year. On Wednesday, he came to drink tea near Janeshwar Park in a Verna car accompanied by another girl. As soon as Anamika found out, she arrived at the spot. Upon seeing Shahnawaz with another girl, an argument broke out between them. During this altercation, Anamika discovered that the accused's real name was Shahnawaz, not Yash. Infuriated by this revelation, she started shouting. Seeing the situation escalate, the girl who had come with Shahnawaz left the scene. After this, Shahnawaz got into his car and tried to flee. Anamika stood in front of the car to block him, whereupon Shahnawaz drove forward, hit her, and sped away. An eyewitness recalled: "We saw a car come to a stop first. A short while later, two people arrived there on a scooter. There were two people inside the car as well. As soon as the scooter stopped, the car began moving slowly. The woman riding the scooter tried to stop the car, so the driver pulled over a short distance away." "When people approached to talk to him, he suddenly sped off in the car. The girl sustained severe injuries in the incident, including a broken arm. She was crying out in pain and pleading while weeping, 'God, save me. I am going to die.' The incident occurred around 6:00 AM while I was on my way to serve tea to customers."

stories.title: ‘If I don’t kill them, they will kill me’:Muzaffarnagar security guard’s son demands encounter of accused, threatens revenge
stories.summary: Just as my father was shot dead, the police should also kill his killers in an encounter. If that does not happen, I will be forced to take revenge. My family has been destroyed. If I do not kill them, they will kill me. Saying this, Sagar, the son of security guard Subhash Baliyan, broke down in tears. Subhash was shot dead at around 10.30am on 15 September while he was cycling to work. The attackers stopped him and shot him in the chest. The incident took place in Kinoni village, under Shahpur police station, around 45 km from the district headquarters. Subhash’s elder son, Aakash, is in jail on charges of eloping with a girl from the village. The family suspects that Subhash was killed because of the enmity arising from the relationship. A village council meeting was held over the matter two days earlier, where the girl gave a statement in favour of Aakash before being sent to Nari Niketan. Read what younger son Sagar said Sagar said his father had been travelling to work on his bicycle when he was shot. “The accused had been calling my father and me to their house. They had planned to kill both of us. By chance, we did not go. They wanted to create an impression that we had attacked their house and that they had killed us in retaliation. “The accused belong to an influential family in the village and have licensed guns. My brother Aakash is in jail even though he has not committed any offence and the girl has given a statement in his favour. The police have been negligent. They took one-sided action and sent my brother to jail without considering the girl’s statement. He said- “I want security for myself and my family. Just as they shot my father, the police should shoot them. I want support from the police administration and want the accused to be killed in an encounter. Otherwise, the matter will escalate further and I will have to take revenge. “If the police administration takes no action and I am not given security, I will avenge my father’s death myself. My home has been destroyed. My brother is in jail, my father is dead and my mother is ill. I am the only one left. If I do not kill them, they will kill me. If I had gone with my father, they would have killed me that day.” Subhash worked as a security guard at a private factory Subhash, 50, was a resident of Kinoni village in the Shahpur police station area. He worked as a security guard at a private factory near Budhana Mod. His family comprises his wife, Mamta alias Pinky, and two sons, Sagar, 26, and Aakash, 25. Subhash owned seven bighas of land, which the family cultivated. Satender’s family also lived in the village. He has a son, Hariom alias Shubham, 25, and a 22-year-old daughter. Satender owned 18 bighas of land, which the family cultivated. Subhash’s son Aakash was in a relationship with Satender’s daughter. Although the two belonged to the same caste, their families were opposed to the marriage. Aakash eloped with the girl a month ago Around a month ago, Aakash left home with the girl. Her family filed a case against him. Police traced the couple and sent Aakash to jail, while the girl was sent to Nari Niketan in Meerut. The dispute between the two families intensified after this. A village council meeting was held two days ago, during which the girl gave a statement in favour of Aakash. She was subsequently sent back to Nari Niketan. Girl’s father and brother accused of murder On the morning of 15 September, Subhash left home for work. Some people surrounded him and shot him in the chest. His family has accused the girl’s brother, Hariom, and her father, Satender, of the murder. Police have found that the firing was carried out with a .312-bore country-made pistol. Affair-related rivalry angle being investigated SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma said an angle of rivalry arising from the relationship had emerged. He said police were investigating the case from all angles. Police are examining CCTV footage from cameras installed around the crime scene and other evidence to identify the attackers. The SSP said efforts were being made to arrest the accused soon.
